column1: # Courtyard modeling test: Building with internal void zone
# This demonstrates how to model buildings with internal courtyards and atriums.
# The VOID zone excludes interior regions from wake calculations.
# Outer perimeter: 200m x 200m square building complex at z=0-35m
# Internal courtyard: 100m x 100m void zone (no wake generation from interior)
# This represents an atrium or open courtyard space
# Additional building section: separate 40m x 40m structure
